name: section-pin-map
assumes: No single-device pin map is stored under the source package name or its _N-stripped form (a single-device package resolves directly and never reaches this table)
The candidate names are tried in the order findPinMapKey builds them: the source package, then its _N-stripped form

unit_suffix: 'yes' is a suffix on the instance's symbol name under which a pin map is stored for a candidate name (a doubled letter counts through its first letter); 'unmapped' is a suffix no stored map answers to
